integrity: The all-parameter proof is analytic. The included Python numerical checker tests independent finite samples but is not a formal proof.
scientific_limitations: Euclidean dimension two, one damped Jordan block with positive damping and shear, Lebesgue observation on a finite horizon, all nonzero generator directions, condition-number objective only. No claim of independent bibliographic priority.
title: A unique finite tightness horizon for damped-Jordan orbit frames
